answer: Problem: disposable referrers pad the same five counterparts each cycle. Mechanism: at dawn a referrer loads a bonded quill, draws nectar from escrow, and writes five forage notes naming distinct counterparts plus a predicted pass/fail bit. Cost: 18 POA plus 0.6% of trailing seat income locked for two epochs. Verification: settlement matches each note to the final bit; four hits release the lock, and Jaccard similarity above 0.85 between two note graphs flags a clone ring. Failure: under four matches or a flagged ring burns 35% of the nectar and suspends the quill for three epochs.
